adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review recovered source-located MIC, combination FICI, and HGF-1 MTT non-cytotoxicity records from paper XML/PDF text; reconciled linked DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP rows; preserved the mixed dbAMP conflict; and bounded mechanism claims to stability, entry/growth arrest, and unresolved target evidence.
tools_attempted: jq over handoff, packet, final, quality, manifest, locator, and status JSON
rg over paper XML, extracted PDF text, supplementary text index, and linked database JSONL
nl/sed over extracted PDF text for result and method locators
manual row reconciliation of XML/PDF result text with DBAASP/CAMP/dbAMP linked rows

per_layer_decision_rationale.material_packet: Packet material remains material_extracted_with_gaps because the XML-linked Word supplement is absent locally, but XML/PDF/database material is sufficient for the recovered activity, toxicity, database, and mechanism claims.
per_layer_decision_rationale.validator_contract: The structural validator surface is contract-ready after repair; activity, database, mechanism, and review artifacts are present and source-located.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP/CAMP rows that match current-paper MIC or HGF-1 results are source_verified; the dbAMP mixed multi-PMID/multi-target row is preserved as source_conflict.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Six primary-source activity/toxicity records were recovered without fabricating exact figure-only percentages or unsupported units.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Direct evidence is limited to stability and time-lapse cell-entry/growth-arrest assays; membrane target language remains hypothesis/context.
per_layer_decision_rationale.publication_grade_review: No blocking or major QC issue remains after bounded obtainable-only source review; acceptance is caution-bearing, not clean.

caution_findings.evidence_context: The dbAMP row is a mixed multi-PMID/multi-target database entry; current-paper-supported C. albicans values are preserved separately and the broader row remains source_conflict.
The paper uses potentiation/synergized language in places, but the source FICI value is 0.75 and is categorized by the authors as additive by EUCAST.
Figure-only curve/bar values were not invented; source text values and qualitative thresholds were preserved.
Local supplement assets are HTML landing pages; XML-linked Word supplement is absent locally and appears limited to saliva donor characteristics.
Direct microscopy supports cell entry/growth arrest; the source does not identify the exact cellular target.

tools_attempted: rg for MOESM/supplement links in XML and local HTML landing assets
unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The XML advertises Supplementary Dataset 1 as 41598_2018_27417_MOESM1_ESM.doc, but the local paper package contains only repeated HTML landing-page .bin assets and no local .doc/.docx/.xls/.xlsx supplement file. The methods text describes the supplement as donor characteristics for saliva samples; gate-relevant activity, toxicity, identity, and mechanism values were recovered from XML/PDF text.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Nonblocking caution: donor-characteristic supplement content is unavailable locally, but it is not needed to support the recovered MIC, FICI, HGF-1 MTT, database, or mechanism claims.
